subject: Genetics
title: Chromosomal Mutations
description: A micro-lesson that makes Chromosomal Mutations usable.

hook.text: Sometimes it's not a letter that changes—it's a whole chunk of chromosome. Millions of bases moved or flipped.

buildup.text: Deletions remove segments. Duplications copy them. Inversions flip them. Translocations swap pieces between chromosomes.

discovery.text: The Philadelphia chromosome—a translocation between chromosomes 9 and 22—drives chronic myeloid leukemia.

twist.text: Some chromosomal changes are harmless. Inversions in chromosome 9 occur in 1% of people with no health effects.

climax.text: Scale matters. Small chromosomal shifts may be benign. Large ones can disable dozens of genes at once.

punchline.text: When chromosomes rearrange, the consequences are unpredictable.

quiz.question: What is the Philadelphia chromosome?
options: A chromosome found only in Philadelphia
